resources.string: Choose an itinerary and discover the city\'s best places at your own pace.

Walk Munich is a curated city guide designed to help you discover interesting places and walking routes while exploring Munich.

The routes and recommendations presented in the app are personally curated suggestions, based on individual exploration, research, and personal interest.

The app focuses on walkable experiences, cultural highlights, and local spots, presented in a simple and enjoyable way.

Walk Munich is a non-commercial, personal project created for learning, experimentation, and portfolio purposes.

It is not an official city guide and is not affiliated with the City of Munich, local authorities, or any tourism organization.

Routes, place descriptions, and recommendations reflect personal suggestions and interpretations and may not be complete, up to date, or suitable for every user.

All information is provided “as is” without any guarantees regarding accuracy or reliability.

This app is a personal and educational project created for learning, exploration, and portfolio purposes. It is not affiliated with any official tourism organization or authority. Content is curated from publicly available sources and provided for informational purposes only.

Images, place information, and background content used in this app come from publicly available sources and open references.

Where applicable, sources and attributions are included.

If you believe any content is incorrectly attributed or should be removed, please get in touch.
